# MiniCluster manifest for running kripke on a single AWS ARM CPU node.
# This configuration is tailored for an ARM architecture and AWS EFA networking.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Using an incrementing number in the name to ensure uniqueness.
  name: kripke-minicluster-1
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 to run on a single node as requested.
  size: 1
  # Total number of MPI tasks to run.
  tasks: 1

  # This job will not be cleaned up after completion to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Logging settings. Strict mode ensures the job fails on any Flux error.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux-specific configuration.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture as ARM, as required for AWS ARM instances.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Use the specific Flux container image built for ARM architecture.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Defines the main application container for the Flux job.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke
      # The command to execute. Flux will handle the MPI execution wrapper.
      command: kripke

      # The launcher flag MUST be false. The Flux operator handles job launching.
      launcher: false

      # Resource requests and limits for the container.
      # This is specifically for AWS Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) enabled nodes.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1

# MiniCluster manifest for running kripke on a single AWS ARM CPU node.
# This version corrects previous validation errors and resets the command.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Incrementing name to kripke-minicluster-4 to avoid collision.
  name: kripke-minicluster-4
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster, set to 1 for single-node execution.
  size: 1
  # Total number of MPI tasks to run across the MiniCluster.
  tasks: 64

  # This job will not be cleaned up after completion to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Add backoffLimit as it was identified as a missing required field.
  backoffLimit: 1
  pod:
    # Add restartPolicy as it was identified as a missing required field.
    restartPolicy: "Never"

  # Logging settings. Strict mode ensures the job fails on any Flux error.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux-specific configuration.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture as ARM, as required for AWS ARM instances.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Use the specific Flux container image built for ARM architecture.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
    # Flux option flags to control CPU affinity for better performance.
    optionFlags: -o cpu-affinity=per-task

  # Defines the main application container for the Flux job.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke
      # The command is reset to run kripke with no parameters as per the new instructions.
      command: kripke

      # The launcher flag MUST be false. The Flux operator handles job launching.
      launcher: false

      # FIX: The field for environment variables is `environment` and requires a map, not `env` with a list.
      # These variables are set to configure the EFA provider for MPI.
      environment:
        FI_PROVIDER: efa
        FI_EFA_USE_DEVICE_RDMA: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_pml: cm
        OMPI_MCA_mtl: ofi

      # Resource requests and limits for AWS Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA).
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"

# Corrected MiniCluster manifest for Kripke.
#
# Error Analysis: The previous run failed because the number of MPI tasks (64) did not match
# the application's default decomposition (for 1 task), as the command was run without parameters.
#
# Fix: To satisfy the instruction "Run kripke with no parameters," the number of tasks
# has been changed to 1 to match the application's default expectation. This resolves the
# assertion failure. The incorrect 'environment' list format has also been corrected to a map.
#
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Incrementing name to avoid collision.
  name: kripke-minicluster-6
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster, set to 1 for single-node execution.
  size: 1
  # FIX: Set tasks to 1 to match the default decomposition of the kripke command when run with no arguments.
  tasks: 1

  # This job will not be cleaned up after completion to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false
  backoffLimit: 1

  pod:
    restartPolicy: "Never"

  # Logging settings. Strict mode ensures the job fails on any Flux error.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux-specific configuration for an ARM architecture with CPU affinity.
  flux:
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
    optionFlags: -o cpu-affinity=per-task

  # Defines the main application container for the Flux job.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke
      # Command is reset to run kripke with no parameters as per instructions.
      command: kripke

      # The launcher flag MUST be false. The Flux operator handles job launching.
      launcher: false

      # Environment variables to configure the EFA provider for MPI, using the correct map format.
      environment:
        FI_PROVIDER: efa
        FI_EFA_USE_DEVICE_RDMA: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_pml: cm
        OMPI_MCA_mtl: ofi

      # Resource requests and limits for AWS Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA).
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"
